messages:
Theo (New Hire): Morning team  quick onboarding items I couldn't find in the handbook:
- I moved states right after signing (waaaayyyy quicker than I thought). How do I update my state tax withholding? Do I need to resubmit anything for CA vs WA?
- I opted into the HSA but am not sure if I can change contribution amounts mid-quarter. Is there a window?
- We had to stay in a hotel for two nights while closing on the place; is temporary lodging covered under relocation or do I submit as travel? Also, can I charge it on the company card or expense later?
- Lastly, PTO: do new hires get the full allotment for the year or prorated? I started Mar 10.

Lina (People Ops): Welcome, Theo! :wave: Short answers:
- State tax: update ADP > Myself > Personal Info > State Tax Withholding. If you moved to a different state (WA->CA), you must update ASAP. If you need a form (CA DE-4) we can attach it; otherwise ADP covers most states. @Raj can confirm gotchas for retro payroll.
- HSA contributions: you can change your pre-tax HSA elections during open enrollment or a qualifying life event (QLE). Moving states alone isn't usually a QLE for HSA, but you can change if you have a QLE (e.g., change in family status). We can also do a mid-year manual adjustment if there's an administrative reason  ping @Carmen.
- Hotel: temporary lodging during an eligible relocation is generally reimbursable up to the policy cap. Use expense category "Relocation - Lodging" and add the relocation agreement as backup. Company card use depends on manager/finance; if you have company card access request it first, otherwise expense it and we'll reimburse.
- PTO: prorated by FTE + months remaining in year. Starting Mar 10 will give you a prorated balance; exact days posted in 48 hours to ADP.

Theo (New Hire): Thanks Lina. For state tax, do I need to submit a new W-4 or state-equivalent? I submitted a federal W-4 already.

Raj (Payroll): If you moved to CA you'll need the CA DE-4 (state withholding) in addition to federal W-4. ADP has an upload flow but if you want, DM me the new address and I can file the state form for you. Note payroll cutoffs: any changes after 6pm PST Friday apply next cycle. Also if you had a withholding for WA (no state tax) and move to CA, expect change in net pay.

Theo (New Hire): Got it. DM'ing new address now. About the hotel: the card I used is my personal card. I attached receipt but the portal flagged "missing relocation agreement". Where do I get that form?

Lina (People Ops): Relocation agreement PDF should've been emailed when you signed your offer. Check the onboarding folder: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/relocation. If it's missing, I can re-share. Upload the agreement with the receipt and set category to "Relocation - Lodging". If finance denies, we'll escalate and cover it manually.

Carmen (Benefits): HSA note: you can change contributions mid-year only for QLEs or during open enrollment. However, if your contribution was entered incorrectly we can do an adjustment. If you want to increase/decrease pre-tax payroll deferral due to cashflow, we can tack on a retro correction but need a justification. DM me and we'll look.

Theo (New Hire): Perfect. One more  holiday question: do floating holidays vest immediately or after 90 days? I searched the policy but couldn't find start-delay details.

Lina (People Ops): Floating holidays are available after 60 days of employment (per policy). Standard company holidays apply from day one but floating days have that 60-day wait. We'll show it on your ADP profile once eligible.

Payroll Bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for next run is 2025-06-13 18:00 PST. State tax form uploads after cutoff will apply to subsequent pay period.

Raj (Payroll): Also adding: if you change withholding due to state move and need an estimate of net pay impact, I can run a quick calc for you  LMK the gross salary and desired allowances.

Theo (New Hire): Thanks all, DM'ed address and will upload the relocation agreement once I find it. Appreciate the quick help!
